findingDecisions.basis: Evidence v3 declares 66 named closed typed schemas. The schema audit requires every object field, array item, and tagged-union branch to resolve to an exact primitive or named schema. Runtime validation is exception-contained and recursive E-META scans all parsed semantic boundaries. Malformed roots, nested types, forbidden metadata, removed booleans, dirty base, no-op mutation, and raising mutation all fail deterministically.

E1 rejects duplicate evaluationId/predicateId keys before set commitment, requires memberIds to equal the canonical activated set and declaredCount to equal the list count. E2 binds outcome to claimShape and the exact proof tag. E5 independently replays evaluation-proof.v2 commitments and verdict derivation. All omitted, substituted, duplicate, same-key/different-outcome, and incompatible outcome/proof fixtures reject.

E10 recomputes each full SHA-256 ContentRef from retained canonical bytes and rejects duplicate/same-id-different-byte entries. E4 resolves typed predicate, Coverage, and fact-partition bytes; requires exact coverageId/ref, predicate ref, partition ref, ProjectId, and verificationRequirement equality; derives completeness from equality of required, covered, and partition subject domains; and recomputes subject count/commitment. The independent oracle also recomputed all 21 positive CAS byte-to-digest bindings.

WitnessEdge, anchors, relation semantics, relationship fact bytes, and fact refs are closed and typed. The checker requires canonical nonempty ordered unique edges and anchors, joins every edge field to resolved fact bytes and relationKind to resolved relation semantics, and derives proofObligationId from framed predicateId, claimShape, and exact Coverage ref. Recursive E-META forbids producer-selected obligation metadata.

The reviewed Evidence bytes bind evaluation-proof.v2 c468c131... and retention-tiers.v7 8bf992e7... and invoke their canonical derive_proof_requirements, validate_capability_closure, closure_commitment, and derive_effective_capability APIs. Typed CAS-derived dependency edges must exactly equal the declared graph. One-owner minimum capability, downgrade, alias, omission, unavailable unit, and sealed/effective mismatch fixtures reject. No capability rank is copied into check-evidence.py.

findingDecisions.basis: ReplayClosure contains a nonempty unique list of closed ReplayObject records. Each full replay-closure ContentRef resolves to canonical CAS bytes, maps to exactly its one declared unit, and must be AVAILABLE. ReplayInput dependencyRefs are typed and enter the transitive dependency graph. No locallyResolvable assertion exists; effective replayability is derived by retention v7.

passingSubchecks: PredicateSemantics and PolicySemantics schemas include verifierArtifactRef, irFamily, irMajor, and verifierAbi.
Canonical positive semantics bytes contain those fields.
Cross-major fixtures preserve sealed Run identity and proof migration creates a new Run; rewrite is rejected.
Missing verifier and unsupported ABI fixtures deterministically return UNAVAILABLE and REFUSE-AUTHORITATIVE-READ; Evidence routes unavailable states into retention-v7 capability derivation.
Historical support remains PROVISIONAL with no fixed window, SLA, or cost claim.
Untrusted imperative semantics and Probe are excluded; no public-IR promise is introduced.
blockingFailures: check-versioning.py::_historical_decision parses the semantics bytes but compares only semantics.irFamily and semantics.irMajor to the fixture binding. It never requires semantics.verifierArtifactRef to equal binding.verifierArtifactRef and never requires semantics.verifierAbi to equal binding.verifierAbi. The adjacent binding and trustedVerifierManifest can therefore select the verifier independently of the semantics object's own custody fields.

The CAS entry called verifier-artifact is application/json descriptor bytes containing artifact/version, bundleSignature text, entrypoint text, IR families/majors, and ABI. No content-addressed executable payload ref or executable bytes are present or checked. An entrypoint name is not retained executable custody.

trustedVerifierManifest retains signingKeyId and a signatureRef, and CAS retains a signature-shaped string, but no content-addressed public-key/trust-root bytes are retained. The checker tests kind/presence and literal scheme/bundle labels; it does not bind or verify the signature against retained key bytes and the executable payload.

check-evidence.py E11 delegates acceptance to that incomplete VERSIONING decision. The retained historical-unavailable and unsupported-ABI probes do not exercise a semantics-object verifierArtifactRef/ABI disagreement or absent executable/key custody.
findingDecisions.requiredRepair: Make the canonical PredicateSemantics/PolicySemantics object the source of the historical binding and mechanically require its verifierArtifactRef, IR family/major, and ABI to equal the selected verifier manifest. Retain content-addressed executable payload bytes (or an exact executable payload ContentRef), retained trust-root/public-key bytes, a signature over the exact manifest/payload identity, and exact closure dependencies for semantics -> verifier manifest -> executable/signature/key. Reject any adjacent-binding disagreement. Keep immutable old Runs, deterministic retention-v7 capability reduction/refusal, provisional support, and the declarative-only scope.

newOrdinaryConsistencyFindings.title: Historical verifier custody accepts adjacent metadata without retained executable and key bytes
evidence: The historical decision omits equality checks for canonical semantics.verifierArtifactRef and semantics.verifierAbi against the adjacent binding.
Both verifier-artifact CAS records are JSON descriptors; neither contains or references content-addressed executable payload bytes.
The trust manifest names signingKeyId but the historical CAS contains no public-key/trust-root object and performs no signature verification over executable bytes.
newOrdinaryConsistencyFindings.impact: A nominally AVAILABLE historical verifier does not establish custody of the interpreter bytes or trust material that gives old semantics their meaning. Green missing/ABI refusal paths cannot make the nominal success path authoritative.

finalAssessment.whyGreenProbesDoNotCloseR10EVD07: The retained set covers missing verifier, unsupported ABI, IR-major substitution, scope, fixed-window, and old-Run rewrite cases, but it does not establish the required semantics-object equality to the selected verifier ABI/ref or retain executable and public-key bytes. A regression suite can be complete relative to its declared rows and still omit the required invariant.
